title_en: Shenyang Chemical General Company v. Benxi Thermal Power Plant, et al. — dispute over construction project contract
ruling_gist_en: In litigation mediation, if a non-party agrees to guarantee the performance of the mediation agreement for the parties, the people's court shall permit it and specify the same in the mediation document.

full_text_en:
Shenyang Chemical Construction General Company v. Benxi Thermal Power Plant et al.

— dispute over construction project contract

Ruling Summary

During court mediation, if a third party agrees to guarantee the performance of a mediation agreement for a party, the people's court shall permit it and list the guarantor in the mediation document.

Civil Mediation Document of the Supreme People's Court

(2004) Min Yi Zhong Zi No. 98

Appellant (Original Defendant): Benxi Municipal People's Government.

Legal Representative: Li Bo, Mayor of the city. Address: No. 18 Renmin Road, Pingshan District, Benxi City, Liaoning Province.

Agent ad litem: You Jing, lawyer of Benxi Legal Aid Center.

Agent ad litem: Wang Jinwei, lawyer of Liaoning Pingzheng Law Firm.

Appellee (Original Plaintiff): Shenyang Chemical Construction General Company, address: No. 29 Huigong Street, Shenhe District, Shenyang City, Liaoning Province.

Legal Representative: Cui Guofu, Manager of the company.

Agent ad litem: Yu Lin, lawyer of Liaoning Xinxiya Law Firm.

Appellee (Original Defendant): Benxi Thermal Power Plant, address: No. 32 Jiefang North Road, Mingshan District, Benxi City, Liaoning Province.

Legal Representative: Teng Yixian, Director of the plant.

Agent ad litem: Wang Wei, lawyer of Liaoning Xinwei Law Firm.

Appellee (Original Defendant): Benxi Municipal Central Heating Company, address: No. 32 Jiefang North Road, Mingshan District, Benxi City, Liaoning Province.

Legal Representative: Teng Yixian, Manager of the company.

Agent ad litem: Wang Wei, lawyer of Liaoning Xinwei Law Firm.

Guarantor: Benxi Municipal Heating General Company, address: No. 11 Shifan Street, Pingshan District, Benxi City, Liaoning Province.

Legal Representative: Zhou Jianping, Manager of the company.

In the case of dispute over construction project contract between appellant Benxi Municipal People's Government and appellees Shenyang Chemical Construction General Company, Benxi Thermal Power Plant, and Benxi Municipal Central Heating Company, the Liaoning High People's Court rendered a civil judgment on June 18, 2004, (2003) Liao Min Yi Fang Chu Zi No. 17. The appellant Benxi Municipal People's Government, dissatisfied with the judgment, appealed to this Court. This Court formed a collegial panel according to law and held a hearing on November 30 and December 13, 2004. The appellant Benxi Municipal People's Government's agents ad litem You Jing and Wang Jinwei, the appellee Shenyang Chemical Construction General Company's agent ad litem Yu Lin, and the appellees Benxi Thermal Power Plant and Benxi Municipal Central Heating Company's agent ad litem Wang Wei appeared in court to participate in the proceedings. This case is now concluded.

The court of first instance found the following facts after trial: The Benxi Central Heating Project was urban infrastructure construction carried out by the Benxi Municipal People's Government (hereinafter referred to as Benxi Municipal Government) with the World Bank as the main source of loan funds, for the purposes of solving urban renovation, providing heating for new houses, reducing pollution, and improving the environment. For this project, the Benxi Municipal Government established the Benxi Thermal Power Plant Project Headquarters (hereinafter referred to as the Project Headquarters) on August 27, 1992. On May 12, 1993, the Benxi Municipal Government held a preparatory office meeting for the Benxi Thermal Power Plant (hereinafter referred to as the Thermal Power Plant) project. The minutes of the meeting recorded: "To ensure a better connection for the operation and management of the thermal power plant after completion, it is necessary to form an economic entity as soon as possible – the Benxi Thermal Power Plant Preparatory Office (hereinafter referred to as the Preparatory Office), with the Preparatory Office as the main body, fully authorized to oversee the construction of the thermal power plant and bear economic responsibilities." Later, upon application by the Project Headquarters, the Benxi Municipal Planning Commission issued an approval on June 22 of the same year: "Approval is hereby given for the establishment of the 'Benxi Thermal Power Plant Preparatory Office.' The Preparatory Office is under the custodial management of the Benxi Municipal Planning Commission, fully authorized to oversee the construction of the thermal power plant and bear economic responsibilities." Zhang Bi was appointed as Director of the Preparatory Office. On June 30 of the same year, with approval from the administrative authority for industry and commerce, the Thermal Power Plant was established, with Zhang Bi as its legal representative.

On March 26, 1994, the Preparatory Office and Shenyang Chemical Construction General Company (hereinafter referred to as Chemical Construction Company) signed the "Benxi Central Heating Project (Dongfen Area) Contract," stipulating that the Preparatory Office would contract out to Chemical Construction Company the construction of the Tai Zi River Pump Station Project, the Heating Pipeline Project, and the Heat Exchange Station Project within the Benxi Central Heating Project. The estimated total project cost was RMB 19,990,932, with a construction period of seven months. After the contract was signed, Chemical Construction Company fulfilled its construction obligations, and Benxi Municipal Government raised no objections. On November 28, 2001, the Thermal Power Plant (Preparatory Office) Project Headquarters and Chemical Construction Company confirmed the payment status of the project funds, namely, the net final account value for the three packages A, B, and C of the Benxi Central Heating Project was RMB 21,020,204.78, project funds and material payments already made to Chemical Construction Company totaled RMB 11,332,391.33, and outstanding project funds amounted to RMB 9,687,813.45. On November 30 of the same year, the Project Headquarters and Chemical Construction Company signed a project settlement statement, with the audited project cost value being RMB 23,580,204.78.

The court of first instance further found that on April 5, 1994, to meet the World Bank's requirements for loans and the state's requirements for environmental protection, the Thermal Power Plant established the Benxi Municipal Central Heating Company (hereinafter referred to as the Heating Company), which was approved by the administrative authority for industry and commerce. The legal representative of the Heating Company was Zhang Bi. The company and the Thermal Power Plant operated as "one team, two nameplates."

On October 28, 2001, the Thermal Power Plant was revoked of its business license as a legal person by the administrative authority for industry and commerce for failing to participate in annual inspections for several years.

On September 4, 2003, Chemical Construction Company filed a lawsuit with the court of first instance, alleging that after participating in a bidding process, it signed six project contracts with the Preparatory Office on March 26, 1994, for the Benxi Central Heating Project (Dongfen Area), contracting to construct the Tai Zi River Pump Station Project, the Heating Pipeline Project, and the Heat Exchange Station Project under the Benxi Central Heating Project contracted by Benxi Municipal Government. After the project was completed, based on the settlement between Chemical Construction Company and the Project Headquarters, the total project cost was determined to be RMB 23,580,204.78. Benxi Municipal Government had paid project funds of RMB 11,332,391.33, leaving an outstanding balance of RMB 12,247,813.45 in project funds and interest of RMB 8,492,729.60. Due to Benxi Municipal Government's default on project funds, Chemical Construction Company incurred liquidated damages of RMB 1,490,089.60 for failing to repay equipment and material debts promptly, along with interest and legal fees of RMB 5,469,074.91 arising from this. Additionally, because Benxi Municipal Government had not reimbursed Chemical Construction Company for equipment and material payments advanced by it, an interest amount of RMB 2,668,104.90 accrued. In summary, Chemical Construction Company requested a judgment ordering Benxi Municipal Government to pay the outstanding project funds of RMB 12,247,813.45, pay interest of RMB 8,492,729.60 on the project funds, compensate for economic losses of RMB 6,959,164.51, and pay interest of RMB 2,668,104.90 on the advanced project funds.

Benxi Municipal Government argued in its defense that it was the initiator or preparer of the Thermal Power Plant central heating project, and the Preparatory Office was a "legal person in preparation" for the project. Debts arising from contracts signed by the Preparatory Office should be borne by the Thermal Power Plant established through the preparation process, so the Thermal Power Plant should be listed as the defendant in this case. The separated Heating Company enjoys property rights over the Thermal Power Plant and should also assume joint liability for the central heating project's debts; therefore, the Heating Company should also be added as a co-defendant in this case. Benxi Municipal Government argued that it was neither a debtor nor a defendant in the contract dispute lawsuit and requested the dismissal of Chemical Construction Company's lawsuit.

The Thermal Power Plant and the Heating Company argued in their defense that they were the direct beneficiaries of Benxi Municipal Government's investment, legally enjoying all assets of the Thermal Power Plant project construction and should also bear all debts of the project construction. They had no objection to the outstanding project funds owed to Chemical Construction Company and expressed willingness to assume full repayment obligations.

During the trial at the court of first instance, Chemical Construction Company, Benxi Municipal Government, the Thermal Power Plant, and the Heating Company all had no objection to the outstanding project funds of RMB 9,687,813.45. The Thermal Power Plant and the Heating Company expressed willingness to assume the obligation to pay the outstanding amount.

The court of first instance held that the central heating project contract signed between the Preparatory Office and Chemical Construction Company represented true intentions, did not violate legal provisions, and should be valid. The project funds and interest overdue from Benxi Municipal Government should be paid. Regarding Benxi Municipal Government's argument that it did not sign the construction project contract with Chemical Construction Company and was not a party to the contract, thus should not bear the obligation for the overdue debt, the court found that the central heating project was a special project established by the government. Its initiation, organizational establishment, and funding sources were all decided and implemented by Benxi Municipal Government. The project contract was also signed by the Preparatory Office established by Benxi Municipal Government and Chemical Construction Company. The entities entering into and performing the contract were both the Preparatory Office. Since the Preparatory Office, as a subordinate department of Benxi Municipal Government, did not have legal person status, it was not improper for Benxi Municipal Government to be the subject of litigation in this case and assume the obligation to pay the outstanding project funds. Benxi Municipal Government's defense arguments could not be sustained. During Chemical Construction Company's construction of the Thermal Power Plant project, the Thermal Power Plant participated in the performance of the construction project contract between Benxi Municipal Government and Chemical Construction Company and paid part of the project funds. After the project was completed, all physical results of Benxi Municipal Government's preparatory work were transformed into the Thermal Power Plant. As beneficiaries of Benxi Municipal Government's investment, the Thermal Power Plant and the Heating Company expressed willingness to assume the obligation to pay all outstanding project funds; therefore, the Thermal Power Plant and the Heating Company should jointly assume the obligation with Benxi Municipal Government to pay the outstanding project funds and interest.

Regarding Chemical Construction Company's claim for compensation of economic losses of RMB 6,959,164.51 from Benxi Municipal Government, because this originated from economic disputes between Chemical Construction Company and other entities, which did not belong to the same legal relationship as this case, it was not supported. Regarding Chemical Construction Company's request for Benxi Municipal Government to pay interest of RMB 2,668,104.90 on the advanced project funds, as the second claim for interest on project funds was for interest on the entire outstanding amount, this request constituted double counting and was not supported.

In summary, pursuant to Article 106, Paragraph 1, and Article 108 of the General Principles of the Civil Law of the People's Republic of China, the judgment was as follows: (1) Benxi Municipal Government, the Thermal Power Plant, and the Heating Company shall jointly pay to Chemical Construction Company the outstanding project funds of RMB 9,687,813.45 within 15 days from the effective date of the judgment; (2) Benxi Municipal Government, the Thermal Power Plant, and the Heating Company shall jointly pay to Chemical Construction Company interest on the outstanding project funds, calculated at the benchmark interest rate for loans of the same type and same term of the People's Bank of China, from November 30, 2001, to the date of payment, within 15 days from the effective date of the judgment; (3) Chemical Construction Company's other claims were dismissed. Court acceptance fee of RMB 161,849, with Benxi Municipal Government bearing RMB 63,930.50, the Thermal Power Plant and the Heating Company jointly bearing RMB 63,930.50, and Chemical Construction Company bearing RMB 33,988.

Benxi Municipal Government, dissatisfied with the judgment of first instance, appealed to this Court, requesting the judgment be vacated and a judgment be rendered according to law.

During the second instance of this Court, with the mediation hosted by this Court, the third party Benxi Municipal Heating General Company expressed willingness to participate in the mediation of this case, provide guarantee for the performance of debts by the Thermal Power Plant and the Heating Company to Chemical Construction Company, and submitted a guarantee contract to this Court. Pursuant to Article 11 of the Supreme People's Court's Provisions on Several Issues Concerning the Mediation Work of People's Courts, this Court permitted it.

Through friendly negotiation, mutual understanding, and mutual compromise between the parties and the guarantor Benxi Municipal Heating General Company, the following Mediation Agreement was voluntarily reached:

1. Shenyang Chemical Construction General Company waives all claims against Benxi Municipal People's Government in this case and will not raise any other requests separately.

2. Benxi Thermal Power Plant and Benxi Municipal Central Heating Company shall pay to Shenyang Chemical Construction General Company project funds of RMB 9,687,813.45. The first installment of RMB 4.8 million shall be paid within 30 days from the effective date of this mediation agreement; the second installment of RMB 4,887,813.45 shall be paid off within one and a half years, i.e., RMB 3 million shall be paid before December 30, 2005, and RMB 1,887,813.45 shall be paid before June 30, 2006. Interest on the above project funds shall no longer be paid.

3. If Benxi Thermal Power Plant and Benxi Municipal Central Heating Company fail to pay the second installment of RMB 4,887,813.45 in project funds within the time limit and in the amount stipulated in this mediation agreement, they shall pay double the interest on the overdue project funds from the date of delay until the date of payment.

4. Benxi Municipal Heating General Company, as guarantor, provides a guarantee for the payment of the second installment of RMB 4,887,813.45 in project funds. If Benxi Thermal Power Plant and Benxi Municipal Central Heating Company fail to pay Shenyang Chemical Construction General Company the project funds within the time limit and in the amount stipulated in this mediation agreement, Benxi Municipal Heating General Company shall assume the obligation of compensatory payment.

5. The court acceptance fees for the first and second instances total RMB 323,698, with Benxi Thermal Power Plant and Benxi Municipal Central Heating Company bearing RMB 161,849 and Shenyang Chemical Construction General Company bearing RMB 161,849.

Upon review, this Court finds that the content of the above Mediation Agreement is a true expression of the parties' voluntarily reached intentions, does not violate legal provisions, and is hereby confirmed.

This mediation document shall become legally effective upon being signed by all parties.

Presiding Judge: Hu Shihao

Judge: Zhang Yafen

Acting Judge: Zhang Yingxin

January 18, 2005

Clerk: Wang Dongying
